confirmedBugs.why: Placeholder text shows in the empty default state of the input, so changing it must change the rendered output.
A leading icon name picked via an iconPicker in the content group renders a glyph next to the link label; setting it on a default NavLink should visibly add or swap that icon.

stateDependent.requiredState: Dropdown/list open, or at least one option selected — a closed single-vs-multi select with no selections can render identically.
Component must currently be in dark theme — the description scopes this label to 'when currently dark'; a default render is presumably light and uses the other label.
Builder holding at least two rules/conditions (or at least one group) so the AND/OR joiner between them is rendered; an empty default builder has nothing to join.
Form must have fields defined whose names match the record keys; the values land as live input values (DOM properties), which a default fieldless render and an attribute-level diff would both miss.
Field must be in an invalid/touched state — a value entered (or submit attempted) that violates the rule — so the validation message or error styling renders.
Input must hold a value (user-typed or seeded text); with an empty default field the pattern has nothing to format.
Dropdown must be open; option labels live inside the popup list, and a closed default trigger shows only placeholder/selection text.

Matching `options` must be supplied so the selected values resolve to labels (and/or the dropdown opened to show checked rows); with the default empty option list the values have nothing to render as.
Dropdown must be open — the description says the search field sits inside the dropdown.
`views` must be populated with entries whose ids match — with the default (likely empty) view list there is no label or highlight for an id to select.
Picker popover/dropdown open — preset shortcut labels live in the calendar panel, not on the closed trigger.
Calendar popover open, showing day cells that can be marked disabled/out-of-range.
Calendar popover open, showing day cells that can be marked disabled/out-of-range.
Saved-views menu/dropdown opened — the preset labels are listed inside that menu rather than inline on the bar.
At least one condition/rule row present (or the field selector opened) — an empty builder shows only an 'Add condition' affordance.
avatarUrl empty/unset so the avatar falls back to initials; with a default avatarUrl present the initials are never rendered
Wizard advanced to its final step, where the submit button replaces the Next button
Feed holding entries that carry categories, so filter chips have something to render
photoUrl unset/empty so the legacy src fallback path is taken (and the image actually resolves)
cta set to a complete {label, href} object; the card renders no CTA element at all when it is absent or malformed
A non-zero value bound to the gauge (and/or a scale with min/max tick labels enabled)
Component must be holding marker/region data; with no markers or regions defined there are no labels for the toggle to show or hide.
Component must be in the loading state (query in flight, results not yet resolved) for skeleton rows to render at all.
Component must be in the empty state — a query that has run and returned zero matches.

Component must hold segment values whose sum differs from the supplied total; with no segments, or with total left at the 0/omitted default that falls back to the segment sum, the geometry is unchanged.
Panel must be holding at least one priced line item or a rendered total; an empty cart has no monetary value to format.
Heatmap must be holding a non-empty data matrix so cells actually render; with no cells there is no numeric label to show or hide.
The items binding must resolve to a non-empty array of { label, value } objects at render time; an actionPicker-set reference with no backing data yields an empty list.
A resolvable delta object { value, direction } must actually be supplied/bound; the tile renders no delta affordance when the bound data is absent.
A resolvable array of numbers must be supplied/bound so the sparkline has a series to draw; with no numeric data no sparkline is rendered.
The displayed amount must be large enough for compact notation to differ (roughly >= 1000); for a small or zero default amount '$42' is identical compact or not.

The chart must have series (and xKey) configured that match the row keys, and the actionPicker binding must resolve to an actual array; with nothing to plot, any data value renders the same empty chart.
The chart must be holding resolved data rows whose keys match each series dataKey; with no data the series definitions produce no marks or legend entries.
The actionPicker binding must resolve to a real array of column defs (and typically rows to populate them); an unresolved binding leaves the grid in its empty state for every value.
Columns must be defined with keys matching the row objects, and the bound data source must resolve; without columns or a resolving binding the grid shows its empty state regardless of rows.
The grid must hold enough rows to exceed the viewport (the description implies 100+) for windowed rendering to change which row nodes exist; with few or no rows both settings render identically.
The grid must have resolved columns/rows so a checkbox column and header checkbox have somewhere to render; an empty default grid shows no rows to select.
Grid must be holding at least one row; the expander affordance is per-row, and the detail content itself only appears after a row is actually expanded.
The picker must be bound to a real array of column definition objects; with an unbound or non-conforming binding the grid falls back to its default/empty column set.
The grid must be bound to real row data keyed by column.key; with no resolvable data it renders its empty/default body regardless of which picker value is selected.
A footer rollup object must actually resolve (and the grid must be showing its totals footer); an unresolved actionPicker binding leaves the footer absent or unchanged.
Bound to a valid array of { key, label, width? } objects; otherwise the table keeps its default header set.
Bound to a valid array of { key, label, width? } objects; otherwise the sortable table keeps its default header set.
Timeline must be holding real entry data ({ timestamp, title, ... }); without a resolving binding it shows its default or empty timeline.
Card open — trigger hovered or focused so the hover panel is rendered.
Card open — trigger hovered or focused so the hover panel is rendered.
Popover open — the panel (and its title) is only rendered/visible once the popover is triggered.
Popover open — the panel body is only rendered/visible once the popover is triggered.
Tooltip shown — trigger hovered or focused so the hint bubble renders.
At least two breadcrumb items present, so a separator is rendered between them.
Command palette open, so the command list is rendered.
Command palette open, so the search input (and its placeholder) is rendered.
